tasks.title: Store the GitHub integration on the workspace
tasks.description: Add integrations.github (enabled, secret with select:false, autoTransition, connectedAt) to server/src/models/workspaceModel.ts and mount the raw-body parser for /api/integrations/github before express.json in server/src/app.ts.

tasks.title: Write the pure GitHub event helpers
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/githubEvents.ts: verifySignature and signBody (constant-time HMAC-SHA256), extractTaskKeys with per-surface case rules and caps, safeGithubUrl, TRANSITIONS/nextStatus and the payload-to-plan function.

tasks.title: Build the webhook receiver
tasks.description: Add server/src/controllers/githubWebhookController.ts and server/src/routes/integrationRoutes.ts: slug pattern check, workspace lookup with the integration enabled, decoy verification for unknown slugs, ping/ignored/invalid-JSON answers, upsertTaskLink, transitionTask and the audited task.updated entry.

tasks.title: Expose the GitHub settings API
tasks.description: Add server/src/controllers/integrationController.ts and the five workspace routes: view (secret only while enabled, Cache-Control no-store), enable, regenerate-secret (409 when disabled), PATCH autoTransition with a validator and disable, each audited as integration.updated.

tasks.title: Cover the integration with integration tests
tasks.description: Add server/src/__integration__/github.test.ts: settings API behaviour, webhook authentication (signature, slug probing, ping) and linking/transitions.

tasks.title: Model webhooks and deliveries
tasks.description: Add server/src/models/webhookModel.ts (secret select:false, events, active, failureCount, lastDeliveryAt, caps 10 and 20) and server/src/models/webhookDeliveryModel.ts (status, attempt, responseStatus, durationMs, error, requestBody 8 KB, 14-day TTL).

tasks.title: Write the payload and signature helpers
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/webhooks/payload.ts: generateWebhookSecret, signBody/verifySignature, matchesEvent and buildPayload with the byte budget that keeps the stored body re-sendable.

tasks.title: Implement the SSRF guard
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/webhooks/ssrf.ts: checkWebhookUrl (scheme, credentials, port per environment, blocked IP literals), isBlockedAddress and resolvePublicAddresses with IPv4/IPv6 classification and the production/development port sets.

tasks.title: Implement signed delivery and its log
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/webhooks/deliver.ts: sendWebhookRequest with a 5 s timeout, the guarded lookup, redirects disabled and the body discarded; deliverToWebhook that records the attempt and maintains failureCount/lastDeliveryAt/auto-disable.

tasks.title: Dispatch recorded activity to webhooks
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/webhooks/register.ts: payloadForActivity (workspace slug, actor, summary, task key and url, changes) and dispatchActivity, registered once per process with registerWebhooks() in server/src/app.ts.

tasks.title: Expose the webhook management API
tasks.description: Add server/src/controllers/webhookController.ts and server/src/routes/webhookRoutes.ts: list/create/update/delete with the cap and SSRF check, one-time secret, rotate-secret, test ping, deliveries list and redeliver, all behind protect + rejectApiToken + settings:manage.

tasks.title: Cover signing, matching and the guard with unit tests
tasks.description: Add server/src/__tests__/webhooks.test.ts: signing/verification, event matching and payload trimming, isBlockedAddress classification, checkWebhookUrl rules and the resolution/target validation path.

tasks.title: Cover webhook management with integration tests
tasks.description: Add server/src/__integration__/webhooks.test.ts: access, create/manage (cap, validation, one-time secret, rotate, test), delivery (local receiver, failure counting) and the SSRF guard.

tasks.title: Model tokens and their generation
tasks.description: Add server/src/models/apiTokenModel.ts and server/src/utils/apiTokens.ts: tm_ + base62 generation without modulo bias, keyed PBKDF2 digest, format check, scope/expiry helpers and the caps (10 active, 365 days, name 60).

tasks.title: Authenticate tokens in protect
tasks.description: Extend server/src/middleware/authMiddleware.ts: recognise a token, resolve it by digest, refuse it outside workspace routes, refresh lastUsedAt at most once a minute, attach req.apiToken, and add the rejectApiToken middleware.

tasks.title: Bind tokens to a workspace and to their scopes
tasks.description: Extend server/src/middleware/permissionMiddleware.ts: refuse a token for another workspace, refuse a permission the token lacks, and set req.permissions to the intersection of the role and the scopes.

tasks.title: Expose the token API
tasks.description: Add server/src/controllers/tokenController.ts and server/src/routes/tokenRoutes.ts: list (own, active), create (scope subset, cap, expiry) and revoke (own, or any with settings:manage), recording token.created/token.revoked, behind protect + rejectApiToken + tasks:read.

tasks.title: Cover the token lifecycle with tests
tasks.description: Add server/src/__tests__/apiTokens.test.ts (generation, digest, scope and expiry helpers) and server/src/__integration__/apiTokens.test.ts (create/list/revoke, scope enforcement, workspace binding, rejectApiToken).

tasks.title: Build the developers feature module
tasks.description: Add client/src/features/developers: api (tokensApi, webhooksApi), hooks, lib/catalog (scope groups, expiry options, event groups and labels), lib/snippets (curl and signature verification) and the dialogs, lists and sections.

tasks.title: Add the developers page
tasks.description: Add client/src/pages/DevelopersPage.tsx using useAuthGuard and Sidebar, hosting TokensSection and WebhooksSection with their hooks.

tasks.title: Build the GitHub integration card
tasks.description: Add client/src/features/integrations (api, types, GitHubIntegrationCard) and host it in client/src/pages/WorkspaceSettingsPage.tsx: enable, copy the receiver URL and secret, switch autoTransition, regenerate and disable.

tasks.title: Cover the client surfaces with tests
tasks.description: Add client/src/features/developers/__tests__/{components,lib}.test.tsx, client/src/features/integrations/__tests__/GitHubIntegrationCard.test.tsx and the workspace settings page test.
